name: Google Chrome
layout_summary: Top strip: open tabs with '+' button immediately to the right of the last tab. Below tabs: Back, Forward, Refresh, centered Address/URL bar, extensions, and three-dots menu at far right.
avoid_traps: Do NOT click the three vertical dots (kebab menu) at top-right to open a new tab — use press_key('ctrl+t') or click the '+' button on the tab bar.
Do NOT click the current tab title to type a URL — use press_key('ctrl+l') to focus the address bar.

new_tab.visual_fallback: smart_click('the + button on the tab bar')
new_tab.verify: A new tab opens and the address bar is focused

close_tab.visual_fallback: smart_click('the x close button on the active tab')

reopen_closed_tab.verify: The most recently closed tab is restored

focus_address_bar.visual_fallback: smart_click('address and search bar at top')
focus_address_bar.verify: The URL/address bar text is highlighted and ready for typing

navigate_to_url.visual_fallback: smart_type('address and search bar at top', url, submit=true)
navigate_to_url.verify: The browser navigates to the target URL or search query

next_tab.visual_fallback: smart_click('next tab on the top tab strip')
next_tab.verify: The next tab to the right becomes active

prev_tab.visual_fallback: smart_click('previous tab on the top tab strip')
prev_tab.verify: The previous tab to the left becomes active

find_on_page.verify: Find bar popup appears at top-right of the page

refresh.visual_fallback: smart_click('Reload circular arrow button left of address bar')

back.verify: Browser navigates back to previous page
